name: Chart
description: Time series drawn as a line or area, bound to a resource or given as points.

source.description: Resource binding that supplies the series. Use either `source` or `points`.

points.description: Points the page already holds, as `{ time, value }` with `time` in milliseconds since the epoch

windows.description: Time windows the viewer can choose. The first is selected.

scale.description: Which end of the value axis is bad

yRange.description: Fixed value axis range. Samples outside the range are clipped.

referenceLine.description: One fixed value to mark, such as a threshold

exaggerate.description: Tighten the value axis so small movements fill the height

lineWidth.description: Stroke width of the plotted line

showValue.description: Print the latest value over the chart

label.description: Accessible description of what is plotted
